intent.problem: The original #709 PR #716 correctly preserves an archived completed Work Item but hosted template-smoke failed aggregate coverage by 0.01 percentage points. Merging current main into that old candidate causes generated-evidence conflicts, and manually resolving them would violate the governed conflict boundary. The original feature therefore remains undelivered despite its archive.
constraints: Use the existing GitHub Issue #709; do not create another Issue.
Start the replacement from the exact current origin/main commit and treat the #709 archive and PR #716 as immutable evidence.
Do not manually resolve the failed merge, rebase, force-push, lower coverage, fabricate a receipt, or mutate provider state outside the canonical PR lifecycle.
Update source, installed template, tests, and generated capability/documentation projections together.
